title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1973-04-02

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a stellar show highlighted by a blistering Here Comes Sunshine jam and Jerry’s blazing guitar work.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean soundboard source with only minor bleed from crowd noise (Donna’s screams) that doesn’t detract from the overall clarity.  The concert is repeatedly praised as one of the band’s best, featuring an inspired Weather Report Suite, a knockout Here Comes Sunshine > Eyes of the World jam, and strong performances throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: All substantive reviews give five‑star ratings and focus on excellent musical performance; recording quality is described as generally clear with only slight crowd interference.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear mix overall; a little bleed from Donna’s screaming during Jerry’s solo, but no drop‑outs or major distortion noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight first set with solid vocal harmonies and concise jams; second set builds into a powerful Here Comes Sunshine > Eyes of the World sequence, delivering a high‑energy climax before a satisfying encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ‘very on all night’, sharp, explorative, blazing, and delivering tear‑through solos that drive the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for his solid contribution on Box of Rain alongside Donna’s vocals.
